neighbours.label: ' We' or ' Our' in a company's sales copy (We have everything for your kitchen; We're standing by), as opposed to They or It and other prose
fire:
See all our service areas.
We repair roofs throughout Texas.
Have a look at our wide selection. We carry everything for your garden.
We look forward to serving you soon!
Call us today. We're ready to help.
Our technicians are licensed and insured.
We offer free estimates on all jobs.
Contact us now. We guarantee your satisfaction.
quiet:
See all the old maps.
They cover roads throughout Texas.
Have a look at the wide river. It runs past the garden.
He looks forward to the summer.
Call him today. He is at home.
Her parents are tall and funny.
They walked a long way in the rain.
Rain fell on Monday. It stopped by noon.

short: We / Our in a company's sales copy
notes: A first-person 'We' in other genres isn't tested here.
